content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am excited to get started, but I would like to propose a small adjustment before I sign: - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms exclude indemnification obligations from the liability cap, which could expose me to unlimited financial risk. I propose updating this so that the liability cap applies to all claims and liabilities arising under the agreement, including indemnification obligations. Best regards, I look forward to hearing from you.
